summary: Iteration 7 verifies the NEW hidden-modules feature (Android-style 7-tap version reveal), the mind map reveal/focus enhancements, sidebar/palette/route gating, and the not-configured Google integration. BACKEND 22/22 pytest PASS (attachments 9 + phase3 9 + modules 4). FRONTEND live at http://localhost:3000, real Firebase login test.arshnaz@example.com. VERIFIED: (a) Login + settings navigation, About tab clickable via 'button:has-text(درباره)'. (b) 7 taps on settings-version-tap open modules-panel dialog. (c) All 3 module rows (module-row-pharmacy/study/mind) render with switches in checked state; module-codes-admin panel visible because test user is in ARSH_ADMIN_EMAILS. (d) Wrong code (WRONG-1234) rejected; master code entered as normalized 'arshnaz 2026' (space/case tolerated) succeeded with toast 'nothing new unlocked'. (e) Turning all three toggles OFF changed each Switch to data-state=unchecked and immediately hid sections without reload: sidebar aside no longer contains فارماسی, مرور, or knowledge/دانش; ذهن label technically remains ONLY as a section header for SOS/crisis which is expected safety behaviour. Command palette (Ctrl+K) after uninstall contains NO pharmacy (فارماسی) and NO mind (ذهن) entries — only Do/Grow/Me items + SOS. (f) Direct navigation while uninstalled: /app/pharmacy, /app/mind, /app/knowledge, /app/checkin, /app/review/pharmacy ALL redirected to /app/today; /app/crisis correctly stayed at /app/crisis. (g) Re-opening panel (7 taps) and toggling all three back ON restored data-state=checked; sections reappear (verified via subsequent bottom-bar test where ذهن tab is present at 390x844). (h) MIND MAP at /app/review/pharmacy → 'نقشه مفهومی' tab: mindmap-reveal-toggle label toggles 'تدریجی' ↔ 'نمایش همه'; mindmap-reveal-progress renders 'shown/total'; mindmap-focus-toggle shows mindmap-focus-hint='روی یک شاخه بزن' when active; clicking a node applied data-testid=mindmap-node-wrap-focus (2 nodes present because the test account's Firebase knowledge base has 0 documents — same empty-data situation flagged in iteration_6). (i) Backend pytest test_google_status_not_configured verifies GET /api/arsh/google/status → configured=false and POST /api/arsh/google/connect → 503, matching the frontend contract. (j) MODULES RESTORED at end: pharmacy/study/mind all data-state=checked before browser close.

notes.note: With an empty knowledge base (0 docs) the mind-map renders only root + empty-state node so mindmap-reveal-progress reads '0/0'. In this degenerate case mindmap-reveal-next remains enabled (not disabled) and its label stays 'بعدی' rather than 'تمام شد'. Not a regression — same seed-data limitation as iteration_6. Consider guarding revealDone as (total===0 || shown>=total) in KnowledgeMindMapView so the empty-map case shows the 'تمام شد' disabled state.

Console logs a Firestore quota warning (subscribeFolders / subscribeTags: 'Quota exceeded for quota metric Free daily reads'). This is environmental for the shared preview project — does not affect the feature under test but future flaky tests may correlate with quota resets.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: In KnowledgeMindMapView.tsx set revealDone = total===0 || shown>=total (and show 'تمام شد' + disable mindmap-reveal-next) for the empty-knowledge-base case so the 0/0 degenerate state matches the spec.

critical_code_review_comments: VersionTapTarget correctly resets tap count after 1.5s idle window and dispatches a plain window event — decoupled from the panel component and easy to unit-test.
AdvancedModulesPanel gates the admin section behind modules.isAdmin — server also enforces ARSH_ADMIN_EMAILS on /modules/admin/codes*, so the client toggle cannot bypass authorisation.

Route gating for uninstalled modules produces a hard redirect to /app/today (verified for /app/pharmacy, /app/mind, /app/knowledge, /app/checkin, /app/review/pharmacy) while /app/crisis is intentionally exempt — safety carve-out is correct.
Command palette entries are filtered by installed modules — no leakage after uninstall.
Mind map focus/dim classes are wrapped with data-testid=mindmap-node-wrap-focus | mindmap-node-wrap-dim only when focusMode is on — DOM stays clean when the feature is off.

rca_of_issue: No new bug. One minor spec-vs-implementation gap: the mindmap-reveal-next button stays enabled and keeps label 'بعدی' when total revealed nodes = 0 (empty knowledge base), rather than showing 'تمام شد' / disabled. Fix is a one-line guard: revealDone = shown >= total || total === 0.
